calibration.notes: Opposite limbs. Walking loads both arms similarly; single-hand activity (typing, mousing, carrying) loads them differently, which is the main source of step disagreement.

sleep.notes: Nightly sleep target that sleep debt is measured against. null = use the standard 8h adult recommendation. Set an integer number of minutes (300-720) to override. Sleep NEED cannot be measured by a ring, so this is a declared value, not an inferred one.

body.notes: Used for heart-rate based energy expenditure. Update weight here if it changes.
